submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Output exactly one independent full-body 1254x1254 RGBA game sprite on a genuinely transparent background. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, authoritative for the existing frame03 lower-body pose, face, scale and placement. Image 2 is adjacent frame02; image 3 is adjacent frame04: they define only the upper-body motion trajectory; DO NOT copy their legs or whole poses. Image 4 is character identity; image 5 is the approved painting style. Keep the clean polished Daoist chibi painting, cobalt blue/ivory/gold cloth, dark hair, blue eye and water-pattern folding fan.
Correct only shoulder/chest turn and hand occlusion continuity in WEST frame03, facing screen-left. Image1 already has a useful right fan hand retracted to the abdomen; KEEP that middle arm-swing stage, do not reset to image2 far-front or jump to image3 fully behind. Gently rotate ONLY the upper torso and shoulders toward a more side-on WEST view, halfway between image2 broad front-chest and image3 side/back shoulder. Narrow the visible front lapel moderately; retain a visible ivory front-lapel strip so this is a side transition, not full back view. Advance the near shoulder's turn toward image3 and let the far shoulder become partly occluded, with natural neck connection to the unchanged head. Right elbow stays close to the side, right wrist/fan at waist-abdomen side, fan slightly narrower perspective and beginning partial body occlusion rather than fully across the front. Move the left EMPTY fist away from the fan edge toward the forward side of the torso as it transitions into the image3 forward arm swing, with smooth shoulder-elbow-wrist anatomy. It must clearly be a free hand and never hold the fan. Avoid a sudden back-facing shoulder change. This is a modest local transition correction: preserve exact frame03 legs and boots.
STRICT INVARIANTS: Keep image1 head, face, hair and hair-tassel shapes and positions. Keep image1 hip position, both complete thighs/knees/shins, both boot shapes, angles and positions EXACTLY as in image1. Keep image1 support foot, raised foot, ground height, pelvis size, overall lean, original canvas framing/margins. Do not change the leg phase or straighten/rotate any shoe; do not take legs from images2/3. Only local upper-body arm/shoulder/torso and fan transition changes are allowed. Exactly two anatomically connected arms, two hands, two legs and two boots. The fan is always in the anatomical RIGHT hand, the LEFT hand is empty. Fingers wrap naturally around the fan's narrow handle, no extra grip or extra fingers. No scene, shadow, particle, labels, panels or contact sheet. Keep one original-scale character entirely within the transparent canvas.
